# Newark Law Offices

> Boutique legal representation and strategic advocacy serving corporate and individual clients throughout Texas and Oklahoma.

Newark Law Offices (legal entity: A Newark Firm, LLC) helps people across Texas and Oklahoma with consumer bankruptcy (Chapter 7 and Chapter 13), personal injury, criminal defense, and immigration & removal defense, alongside select corporate, litigation, foreclosure-defense, and insurance-claim work. Offices in Dallas, Texas and Edmond, Oklahoma.

- Responsible attorney: Robert C. Newark, III (Texas and Oklahoma state courts; federal courts in Texas, Oklahoma, Colorado, New Mexico, and Arkansas)
- Attorney Tyler Wilson: licensed in Oklahoma, Alaska, Wisconsin, and South Dakota state courts
- Alaska, Wisconsin, and South Dakota originating matters are accepted on a referral basis
- Local counsel: case-by-case in licensed courts — https://newarkfirm.com/local-counsel.html
- Phone: 866-230-7236 | Dallas: 972-332-5733 | Edmond: 405-727-0269
- Business hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Central Time (both offices). In-office visits by appointment.
- Initial case review: free via https://newarkfirm.com/case-eligibility.html or phone during business hours (does not create an attorney-client relationship)
- Fee structure: personal injury and wind/hail claims may use contingent fees in appropriate cases; litigation, corporate, bankruptcy, and local-counsel work is typically hourly, flat, or retainer-based; all terms in a written agreement — https://newarkfirm.com/contact.html
- Case review: https://newarkfirm.com/case-eligibility.html
- Chat widget and lead forms post to the firm’s Cloudflare Worker; they do not create an attorney-client relationship
- Content library: https://newarkfirm.com/insights.html (the former Blog section redirects here)

## Consumer bankruptcy (Chapter 7 & Chapter 13)

Newark Law Offices helps Texas and Oklahoma consumers stop collection pressure and get a fresh start. Filing triggers an automatic stay that halts most lawsuits, wage garnishment, foreclosure sales, and repossessions.

- [Bankruptcy lawyer (hub)](https://newarkfirm.com/bankruptcy-lawyer.html)
- [Chapter 7 bankruptcy](https://newarkfirm.com/chapter-7-bankruptcy.html): liquidation; discharges most unsecured debt; means test; ~3–4 months
- [Chapter 13 bankruptcy](https://newarkfirm.com/chapter-13-bankruptcy.html): 3–5 year repayment plan; catch up a mortgage or car
- [Stop foreclosure](https://newarkfirm.com/stop-foreclosure.html): automatic stay stops a scheduled sale (TX non-judicial vs OK judicial)
- [Stop wage garnishment](https://newarkfirm.com/stop-wage-garnishment.html): Texas bars most consumer wage garnishment; bankruptcy stops levies
- [Debt collection defense](https://newarkfirm.com/debt-collection-defense.html): answer deadlines, standing, statute of limitations
- [Repossession defense](https://newarkfirm.com/repossession-defense.html): stop repossession; discharge deficiency balances
- [Bankruptcy costs](https://newarkfirm.com/bankruptcy-costs.html): court filing fee + attorney fees; Chapter 13 fees via the plan
- [Bankruptcy timeline](https://newarkfirm.com/bankruptcy-timeline.html): filing, 341 meeting, discharge
- [Bankruptcy FAQ](https://newarkfirm.com/bankruptcy-faq.html)
- [Bankruptcy vs debt settlement](https://newarkfirm.com/bankruptcy-vs-debt-settlement.html)
- [Life after bankruptcy](https://newarkfirm.com/life-after-bankruptcy.html): rebuilding credit
- [Bankruptcy and lawsuits](https://newarkfirm.com/bankruptcy-and-lawsuits.html)
- [Bankruptcy and judgments](https://newarkfirm.com/bankruptcy-and-judgments.html): discharge + judgment-lien avoidance

## Criminal defense

Newark Law Offices actively defends misdemeanor and felony matters in Texas and Oklahoma. After an arrest: remain silent, do not consent to searches, ask for counsel.

- [Criminal defense lawyer (hub)](https://newarkfirm.com/criminal-defense-lawyer.html)
- [DUI / DWI defense](https://newarkfirm.com/dui-dwi-defense.html): criminal case + short-deadline license hearing
- [Drug charges](https://newarkfirm.com/drug-charges.html): search/suppression issues, diversion
- [Assault charges](https://newarkfirm.com/assault-charges.html), [Domestic violence defense](https://newarkfirm.com/domestic-violence-defense.html), [Protective orders](https://newarkfirm.com/protective-orders.html)
- [Theft charges](https://newarkfirm.com/theft-charges.html), [Probation violations](https://newarkfirm.com/probation-violations.html)
- [Expungement](https://newarkfirm.com/expungement.html), [Record sealing / nondisclosure](https://newarkfirm.com/record-sealing.html)
- [Criminal defense FAQ](https://newarkfirm.com/criminal-defense-faq.html)

## Immigration & removal defense

Immigration courts are federal and nationwide; representation is not limited by state bar licensure. Missing an immigration hearing usually results in an automatic removal order.

- [Immigration lawyer (hub)](https://newarkfirm.com/immigration-lawyer.html)
- [Removal defense](https://newarkfirm.com/removal-defense.html), [Deportation defense](https://newarkfirm.com/deportation-defense.html), [Immigration court representation](https://newarkfirm.com/immigration-court-representation.html)
- [Adjustment of status](https://newarkfirm.com/adjustment-of-status.html), [Family immigration](https://newarkfirm.com/family-immigration.html), [Consular processing](https://newarkfirm.com/consular-processing.html)
- [Bond hearings](https://newarkfirm.com/bond-hearings.html), [Motions to reopen](https://newarkfirm.com/motions-to-reopen.html), [Waivers](https://newarkfirm.com/waivers.html), [ICE detainers](https://newarkfirm.com/ice-detainers.html)
- [Immigration FAQ](https://newarkfirm.com/immigration-faq.html)
